preFooter.aWhatIsDaPay: DaPay is an integrated Indonesian digital transaction and payment ecosystem platform designed to provide fast, secure, and transparent digital service fulfillment. Tailored for individual consumers, gamers, mobile phone counters, and MSMEs (UMKM), DaPay connects users directly to modern digital infrastructure backed by automated 24/7 processing.
preFooter.qWhatServices: What Products and Services Are Available on DaPay?
preFooter.aWhatServices1: The DaPay catalog provides comprehensive digital services including popular online game top-ups, prepaid credit and mobile data packages for all Indonesian telecommunication operators, PLN prepaid electricity tokens and postpaid bill payments, leading e-wallet balance top-ups, digital shopping and streaming entertainment vouchers, PPOB utilities, and hotel & travel bookings.
preFooter.aWhatServices2: Every transaction on DaPay is verified automatically with official invoice issuance ensuring total order accountability. In addition, DaPay regularly announces service improvements, special promotional programs, and new digital product additions through our official channels.
preFooter.qReseller: How Does DaPay Support Resellers, Counters, and MSMEs?
preFooter.aReseller: For business partners including counter owners, resellers, and digital entrepreneurs, DaPay offers ecosystem capabilities that simplify retail operations. With structured catalogs, flexible retail pricing adjustments, and transparent profit margin calculations, partners can manage their digital retail business with greater confidence and organization.
preFooter.qGuestTrans: How to Make Direct Purchases (Storefront / Guest)?
preFooter.guestTransDesc: For fast purchases without registration or login, consumers can transact directly through these practical steps:
preFooter.guestStep1: Select Product & Variant: Browse the DaPay public catalog and pick your desired digital product or denomination.
preFooter.guestStep2: Enter Destination Data: Carefully input your Game User ID (along with Server ID if needed) or phone/electricity meter number.
preFooter.guestStep3: Choose Payment Method: Use official payment channels such as National QRIS, E-Wallets (DANA, GoPay, OVO), or Bank Transfer.
preFooter.guestStep4: Complete Payment: Transfer the exact invoice amount before the payment expiration countdown timer expires.
preFooter.guestStep5: Monitor Order Status: The order fulfills automatically, and progress can be monitored anytime via the Track Order feature.
preFooter.qMemberTrans: How Real Transactions Work for Resellers & MSMEs in the Dashboard?
preFooter.memberTransDesc: For counter owners, resellers, and digital entrepreneurs, DaPay provides integrated real transactions within the Member Dashboard:
preFooter.memberStep1: Sign In & Manage Balance: Log into your member account and top up balance via automated Deposit.
preFooter.memberStep2: Single & Bulk Order Support: Place orders individually or execute bulk orders across multiple numbers simultaneously for maximum efficiency.
preFooter.memberStep3: Instant Balance Deduction: Payments are deducted directly from account balance without repeated manual transfers per order, speeding up counter queues.
preFooter.memberStep4: Custom Selling Price & Margins: Set your own retail counter prices, configure profit margins, and print transaction receipts easily.
preFooter.memberStep5: Centralized Reports & Mutation: All transaction histories, balance mutations, and commissions are recorded automatically for transparent business bookkeeping.
preFooter.qSandbox: What is DaPay Sandbox and How to Run Simulations?
preFooter.sandboxDesc: For partners and users wanting to practice transaction workflows without financial risk, DaPay provides an official simulation mode:
preFooter.sandboxStep1: Access Sandbox Portal: Open the DaPay Sandbox portal via site navigation to launch your simulation session.
preFooter.sandboxStep2: Use Virtual Balance: Leverage virtual simulation funds specifically allocated for testing without using real money.
preFooter.sandboxStep3: Test Single & Bulk Orders: Explore interactive order placement for both single items and bulk catalog orders.
preFooter.sandboxStep4: Simulate Instant Payment: Execute payment simulations with virtual funds to test system responses and receipt generation.
preFooter.sandboxStep5: Master Pricing & Margins: Practice setting counter retail prices and profit margins before executing live transactions.
preFooter.servicesList: Game Top Up • Mobile Credit & Data • PLN Electricity • E-Wallet • Digital Vouchers • PPOB • Hotel & Travel • DaPay Sandbox
